interpretation: On the six source-reviewed local dead-code labels, both arms have four valid literal unused-import detections and two preserved known-used variable bindings. Reviewed local FPR is unchanged at 0/2.

The only finding delta is removal of three generator-owned declaration lint warnings. Their source predicate was true; this is a scope/actionability correction, not evidence of three fewer semantic false positives.
Generated-output warning count is seven before and four after; four literal unused-import warnings in generated output remain. There is no application dead-code true-positive sample here.
Current scanning explicitly reports three unknown generated-provider boundaries and exits 2. Baseline exit 0 without such receipts does not prove complete frontend coverage.
The transient uno.css alert is absent in both matched arms. It was introduced and fixed within the patch and contributes no baseline-improvement claim.

fixed_real_source_controls.rate: Only compute FP/(FP+TN) for the identical verified live controls in both arms. An unsupported, suppressed, abstained or incomplete result cannot establish TN.
fixed_real_source_controls.extraction_note: PHP four classes and two TS functions appear as native definitions in both reports. The three TS exported variables are omitted by JSON definitions formatting; directly parsing the unchanged src/defu.ts with each arm native TypeScriptCore independently extracts defu@52, defuFn@56, defuArrayFn@64 and no parse errors.

regression_comparison.scope: Same 151 development regression cases and fixed current labels, not an independent production benchmark. The before/after comparison changes analyzer code only.

complete_real_repo_known_live_controls.scope: Five defu symbols and four laravel/prompts class/interface controls; not a population estimate.

frontend_generated_output_noise.classification: Generated declaration lint advice removed; the literal lint-disable predicate was true, so this is actionability/noise reduction, not three proven semantic false positives.

conclusions.whole_repository_false_positive_rate_rea: Open-set labels, unknown public APIs, unreviewed policy alerts, unsupported baseline npm checks and incomplete frontend/C++ coverage prevent a defensible overall denominator.

conclusions.interim_css_warning: The temporary uno.css warning was introduced and fixed during development. It is absent in both paired arms and is not a baseline improvement.
